title: Software Engineer
description:
Horizon Platforms is hiring a Software Engineer to build and evolve backend services that power customer-facing product workflows. This is a remote role for engineers who enjoy service ownership, API design, and cloud-native delivery.

You will collaborate with product and platform partners to design reliable services, improve observability, and ship incremental improvements. The team values clear interfaces, pragmatic engineering judgment, and careful production changes.

Our services commonly involve object-oriented backend languages, HTTP APIs, relational data, and cloud infrastructure. Mentions of adjacent technologies in our stack description are contextual and do not all represent hard requirements.

Compensation is competitive and based on experience; a specific salary range is not listed in this posting.
responsibilities: Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs
Collaborate on service reliability, testing, and production readiness
Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions
Work with cloud infrastructure and containerized deployments
Improve observability, operational runbooks, and incident response practices
education_requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
